name: Marcel-Sinan
headline: Turn Dertour’s booking data into trips that bring customers back.
saw: Your homepage sells early booking offers, last minute deals, round trips and hotels to every visitor the same way, whether they arrive for a city break in Europe or a family holiday.

After a booking, what they book, when they travel and which offers they ignore is your strongest signal for the next trip and for the moment someone starts to drift. Today it sits in analytics, not in the message they receive.

Cross-sell, upsell and retention campaigns are built by hand, per segment, per month. The customer who is about to book elsewhere this week gets the same early booking offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the rebooking elsewhere before it happens
cases.text: Churn signals per customer from booking history and support contacts. The right offer, channel and moment for each traveller, such as a flexible cancellation option, tested continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the right next trip
cases.text: Next best trip, hotel or add-on per customer, triggered by past bookings and searches. Replaces blanket early booking mailings sent to everyone, including people who already booked.
cases.kpi_label: conversion vs untargeted campaigns, Tier-1 African MNO

cases.head: Keep every traveller planning, every week
cases.text: Personal destination ideas and magazine articles in email and on your homepage, matched to what each customer clicked. Every customer gets a reason to start planning again.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
